resources.string: Unofficial app, not affiliated with Supercell.
Send /scoutkey to the DeckMate bot in Telegram and paste the key here.
Works without gallery screenshots, but on some phones (Samsung on Android 15) the system hides the game during capture and the shot is black. Then use auto-send above.

A see-through strip with the opponent deck appears by itself after the shot, touches pass through to the game. No Telegram message in this mode. If the deck is not found, the strip shows why and the shot is sent once more.
Permission to display over other apps is granted.
Needs permission to display over other apps.
Note: showing hints over a game during a match may break the game rules. You use it at your own risk.
Drag the strip with your finger
Deck not found, trying once more…
Deck not found. Take the shot later when the opponent nick and clan are visible, or message the bot: /d nick | clan
No answer from the server. Take the shot again.
Ready. Double press the side button or use the tile.
Wrong key. Get a new one: /scoutkey
No key. Open the app and paste it.
Too fast. Wait a few seconds.

Permissions: internet (send the shot), screen capture (only on your press), notification (shows that capture is on), display over other apps (only for the deck strip). The shot is kept in memory and never saved.
Takes a screenshot when you press both volume buttons together and sends it to the DeckMate server. It does not read the screen content or other apps.
Fast mode (deckmate-shot-fast file): both volume buttons take a shot with no dialogs. Enable it in Accessibility settings.
Take a normal screenshot (power + volume down, palm swipe or side button): the app notices it and sends it. No permission dialog and no hidden game. Screenshots stay in your gallery.
Photo access needed: choose Allow access to all photos.
Waiting for a screenshot. Take it as usual.
Cannot see the opponent nick. Take the shot when the nick and clan are visible in the top left corner.
The top half of the screen is off limits: the opponent nick and clan are there. The strip is placed on your side only.
